problems.reason: Both sentences state that Mayr and Goedert proposed the clade Tonsalinae in 2017, repeating the same claim.
Sentence 5 compares the pelvis of Tonsala to that of modern darters, which are fish, not birds, making the comparison about a different group.
Sentence 1 claims Tonsala was larger than its relative Plotopterum, while sentence 27 states it was one of the smallest plotopterids.
